Slop Effects · Beta

Motion graphics editor

Motion design in the browser. Nothing uploaded.

Open now

Slop Effects has these main features: Layers, keyframes and easing; Graph editor and seeded random motion. It opens JSON, Any image, Video.

Beta: still being tested, so some parts may change.

What you can do with Slop Effects

  • Make animated text
  • Add a glitch effect to a video
  • A free After Effects alternative in your browser
